title: paeonia mascula subsp. orientalis
intro: Paeonia mascula subsp. orientalis, commonly known as the oriental peony, is a subspecies of the peony plant that is native to the mountainous regions of Eastern Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce pain and improve wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia mascula subsp. orientalis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which make it useful for treating various health conditions such as arthritis, muscle spasms, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
